info.name: Agent Activity Explorer — Mock API
info.description:
Requests for every endpoint of the take-home mock API (`npm run api` → http://localhost:4000).

**The API fails on purpose:** roughly 5–10% of calls to any endpoint return `500 {"error":"internal server error"}`. If a request fails with 500, send it again. The app retries these automatically.

Run the **Events** folder top to bottom: "List events" saves `nextCursor` and `eventId` as collection variables, which "Next page" and "Get event" then use.

Every request has a saved example response captured from the real server, plus tests (see the Tests tab / Test Results).

request.description: All agent names, for building the agent filter. Returns a plain JSON array of strings.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 500) console.warn('The mock API returns random 500s (~5-10%) on purpose. Send again.');

item.name: Error cases
item.description: All errors share the body shape `{ "error": string }`. 4xx are client errors (the app never retries them); 5xx are transient (the app retries twice with backoff).

exec: pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql("status must be one of ok, blocked, error");

response.name: 400 Bad Request

request.description: Not reproducible on demand: the API fails ~5–10% of requests at random. This request usually returns 200; the saved example shows what a failure looks like. Use the Collection Runner with several iterations to see some.

exec: pm.test('either 200, or the documented 500 body', () => { if (pm.response.code === 500) pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.eql('internal server error'); else pm.response.to.have.status(200); });

originalRequest.description: Not reproducible on demand: the API fails ~5–10% of requests at random. This request usually returns 200; the saved example shows what a failure looks like. Use the Collection Runner with several iterations to see some.
